analysis: Th1 lymphocytes are primarily involved in cell-mediated immunity and are known for producing interferon gamma (IFN-γ), which activates macrophages and enhances the immune response against intracellular pathogens. They are not primarily associated with allergic diseases, mast cell activation, or direct action against extracellular bacteria. While they can recruit neutrophils, their main function is the production of IFN-γ.
